name: search-result-card
title: Search Result Card
description: Ranked search result card with rank badge, metadata, snippet, and relevance bar.

files.content:
"use client"; import type { SearchResultEvent } from "@hitl-kit/core"; import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"; export interface SearchResultCardProps extends Partial>, Omit { className?: string; } /** * Search Result Card. Rank, title, authors, snippet, and a relevance bar. * The relevance is a signal for the human to weigh, not a verdict. */ export function SearchResultCard({ rank, title, authors, venue, year, snippet, relevance, cites, className, }: SearchResultCardProps) { const pct = Math.round(relevance * 100); return (
{rank}

{title}

{authors} , · {venue}, {year} {cites !== undefined && ( <> · {cites} citations )}

{snippet}

{pct}%
); } export const DEMO_SEARCH_RESULTS: SearchResultEvent[] = [ { kind: "result.search", id: "s1", rank: 1, title: "Carbon Pricing Mechanisms and Emissions Outcomes", venue: "Nature Climate Change", year: 2023, authors: "Stavins, R., Stowe, R., Comstock, M.", snippet: "Empirical analysis of 40 carbon pricing schemes across 30 jurisdictions reveals that price levels above $50/tCO₂ are associated with meaningful emissions reductions in the power sector...", relevance: 0.97, cites: 412, }, { kind: "result.search", id: "s2", rank: 2, title: "Just Transition Frameworks in Coal-Dependent Regions", venue: "arXiv", year: 2024, authors: "Newell, P., Mulvaney, D.", snippet: "A systematic review of 28 coal phase-out programmes finds that regions with co-designed transition plans achieved 34% higher re-employment rates within 24 months...", relevance: 0.91, cites: 87, }, { kind: "result.search", id: "s3", rank: 3, title: "Net Zero Pledges: Verification and Accountability", venue: "Science", year: 2023, authors: "Höhne, N., Gidden, M., den Elzen, M.", snippet: "Of 196 national net zero pledges examined, only 31% include robust interim milestones and independent verification mechanisms aligned with 1.5°C pathways...", relevance: 0.88, cites: 301, }, { kind: "result.search", id: "s4", rank: 4, title: "EU Emissions Trading System Post-Reform Price Dynamics", venue: "Energy Economics", year: 2024, authors: "Borghesi, S., Flori, A.", snippet: "The Market Stability Reserve mechanism introduced in 2019 has demonstrably reduced permit surplus, contributing to a tripling of EUA prices from 2018 to 2023...", relevance: 0.84, cites: 156, }, ];
